card.name: Pinyin names of Chinese herbal formulas
card.fires_on: Syllables inside romanized Chinese formula names in parentheses, such as ge gen tang or gui zhi fu ling wan. Also fires partway through herb names just before such a parenthesis, like Pinellia or Atractylodes.

modes.label: Pinyin formula syllables
modes.description: Syllables within the parenthetical pinyin name of a Chinese herbal formula.

modes.label: Herb name before a combination
modes.description: Later parts of Latin herb names that begin a formula name ending in combination or formula.

card.plain: It marks the spelled-out Chinese names of herbal formulas, such as ge gen tang, in texts on traditional Chinese medicine.
